sanskrit_verse:
मृते भर्तरि अपुत्रायाः पतिपक्षः प्रभुः स्त्रियाः ।
विनियोगात्मरक्षासु भरणे च स ईश्वरः ॥
transliteration: mṛte bhartari aputrāyāḥ patipakṣaḥ prabhuḥ striyāḥ | viniyogātmarakṣāsu bharaṇe ca sa īśvaraḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When the husband is deceased and the woman has no son, her husband's brother becomes her guardian for purposes of protection, maintenance, and self-defense.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from relational duty, not ownership
Causation flows from existential necessity and relational continuity
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to dharma-disrupting event
Restoration logic prioritizes survival and structural integrity over individual autonomy
Consciousness alignment occurs through role fulfillment in accordance with cosmic order
executable_legal_axioms: IF husband IS deceased AND woman HAS no son THEN husband’s brother ASSUMES guardianship AUTOMATICALLY
GUARDIANSHIP scope LIMITED TO protection, maintenance, and self-defense ONLY
NO authority BEYOND sustenance and safety UNTIL woman attains self-sufficiency OR alternative arrangement is established
GUARDIAN MUST demonstrate capacity RESTORATION within six lunar months ELSE review jurisdiction BY competent spiritual authority
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes automatic temporary guardianship based on relational proximity and functional need. The threshold of responsibility is activated solely upon verification of death and absence of male progeny. Authority remains provisional until either the woman achieves self-reliance or a higher-order arrangement is made under SPH-guided jurisdiction.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This provision aligns with Nyaya through pramāṇa-based causality—guardianship arises as sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of relational collapse. It reflects proportional responsibility tied to proximity rather than fault. The non-punitive reality rule is upheld since no harm or blame is assigned; instead, structural support is realigned to preserve life flow and dharma continuity.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate immediate assessment of woman’s physical, emotional, and economic status
Assign designated male relative to assume protective-caretaking functions without assuming proprietary rights
Establish monthly review cycles to evaluate progress toward self-sufficiency or identify need for expanded support
Reintegrate guardian into societal dharma framework via ceremonial affirmation of duty-bound service
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Sanatana Dharma Jurisprudence. This law restores natural guardianship aligned with consciousness, not punishment. Reality is non-retaliatory; Dharma prevails through alignment, not force. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
